info.title: EasyEmail Local Server HTTP API
info.description: Authoritative HTTP contract for service/base. Any HTTP-capable program may call this API directly; a published client SDK is not required.

post.summary: Register a Cloudflare Temp Email runtime
Apply credential sets to a provider instance

get.summary: Query observed messages and optionally synchronize providers
List persistent contacts with stable keyset pagination

post.summary: Create or update a contact by normalized email address

patch.summary: Update a contact using version compare-and-swap

delete.summary: Hard-delete a contact using version compare-and-swap

get.summary: List persistent accounts with stable keyset pagination
get.description: The normal scope preserves desktop compatibility by including the system-managed anonymous virtual account.

post.summary: Create normal or Agent-owned account metadata
post.description: Accepts only versioned opaque credential references. Raw passwords, tokens, and authorization codes are rejected.

post.summary: Test an account IMAP profile through an opaque credential reference
post.description: The request never accepts raw credentials. The local runtime resolves the account-owned credential reference through its private credential capability and fails closed when that capability is unavailable.

patch.summary: Update account metadata using version compare-and-swap

delete.summary: Soft-delete account metadata using version compare-and-swap

post.summary: Disable account receive and send capabilities using version compare-and-swap

get.summary: List persistent folders or labels with stable keyset pagination

put.summary: Create or update a folder or label by normalized name

get.summary: Read one persistent folder or label

patch.summary: Update a folder or label using version compare-and-swap

delete.summary: Delete a non-system folder or label using version compare-and-swap

post.summary: Plan a mailbox without opening it
Open or create a temporary mailbox
Send a message from an opened mailbox
Update mailbox session filters or metadata
Recover a mailbox from its address and recovery data
Report business outcome for a mailbox session
Store a message observed by an external caller

get.summary: Synchronize a mailbox and read its verification code
Synchronize a mailbox and read its authentication link

post.summary: Synchronize all mailbox sessions owned by one host

ContactCursor.name: cursor
ContactCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned by the previous page.

AccountCursor.name: cursor
AccountCursor.description: Opaque scope-bound keyset cursor returned by the previous page.

TaxonomyKey.name: key
TaxonomyKey.description: Legacy-compatible ASCII slug derived from the normalized name.

TaxonomyCursor.name: cursor
TaxonomyCursor.description: Opaque taxonomy keyset cursor returned by the previous page.

AccountsResponse.description: Stable page of persistent account metadata

AccountResponse.description: One persistent account and its opaque credential reference metadata

MailTaxonomyListResponse.description: Stable page of persistent folders or labels and adapter capabilities

MailTaxonomyMutationResponse.description: One persistent folder or label and adapter capabilities

MailTaxonomyDeleteResponse.description: Taxonomy deletion result and adapter capabilities

VerificationCodeResponse.description: Verification code when one is available

AuthenticationLinkResponse.description: Authentication link when one is available

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is valid, but the referenced credential was rejected by the remote service

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required local capability or remote service is unavailable

PersistenceUnavailable.description: The required persistent relational capability is disabled or unavailable

secretKey.description: Opaque versioned reference. Callers must not parse it and it never contains secret material.

MailCredentialRefInput.description: Only opaque reference metadata is accepted; password, token, authorization code, and raw secret fields are forbidden.

MailAccountImapTestInput.description: Only account and opaque credential-reference identifiers are accepted. Raw passwords and other secret material are forbidden.

messageReferencePropagation.description: Whether folder and label rename/delete is transactionally propagated into stored message references.
